text: Drink a glass of water after salty meals.
Add one extra fruit or vegetable to your next meal.
If a meal is mostly carbs, add a protein source.
Use fluoride mouthwash at a different time than brushing, for extra cavity protection.
Try a 2-minute strength routine, twice this week — it counts.
Order half greens, half rice instead of all rice.
Ask for sauce or dressing on the side so you're in control.
Drink sweet drinks in one sitting instead of sipping slowly for hours.
Take a short walk after a heavier meal — even 5–10 minutes helps.
Swap one sugary sauce for a squeeze of citrus or vinegar instead.
Box half of a large restaurant portion before you start eating, not after.
Have a glass of water before the meal — it's a small, easy way to slow down.
